capabilities: Meters active note and wikilink neighbor token costs across six models
Bundles a note with 0-2 hop wikilinks and embeds to the clipboard
Redacts secrets, PII and custom aliases into placeholders and restores them
Audits vault token heatmaps, orphan notes and broken wikilinks
Exports folders to redacted, heading-chunked RAG JSONL
disambiguation: Not a vault encryption or access-control tool; redaction only applies to text you copy out of Obsidian.
extras: Free tier covers token metering, context bundling and redaction; the vault audit and RAG JSONL export need a paid Pro license verified offline with ES256. Redaction mappings are held in memory only and cleared on unload.
problem: Pasting notes into AI chats leaks client names, emails and API keys, and there is no way to see how many tokens linked notes will cost before sending.

relations.evidence: Install the community plugin BRAT in Obsidian

summary: Bundles a note and its linked notes into a redacted clipboard pack, with live token and cost estimates and an offline vault audit.
